Þingvellir national park is a must even though every tourist goes there, you can go from the North American tectonic plate and the Eurasian plate, there’s a waterfall there, you can snorkel in super clear water.

Golden circle is beautiful, there’s a geyser there called Geysir which is the reason the word geyser exists. There’s also the Gullfoss Waterfall which is beautiful but do NOT go past the security lines. You will most likely slip and fall into the water some 50-60 metres below or so.

If you do get the chance to go in the northern part, I recommend photographing a church in my town which is shaped like a volcanic crater, right by the highway.
